dqi/kit/ -- what these files are and what is proven about them (added in dataset version 2, 2026-11-20)

kv_unfused5/     353 files (322 .py, 31 .json), 1,756,339 bytes. The DQI kit the line runs on: the team's working copy

                 and CREDITS are the third_party__atakanaldemir_dqi_bundle__* files), carried in its final state.

z9C_oracle.json  7,470 bytes. The zero-trace oracle the chain reads (B5_ZP_ORACLE).
